input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no exit or data-return provision. Section 14 (p0079) addresses only the wind-down of services, and Section 13 (p0078) places the burden entirely on Client to arrange a new name server within 30 days and a new hosting environment within 60 days, while confirming only ownership of domains and Client Content — it imposes no obligation on TrueLink to return Client Content or borrower/loan data in a usable format, to assist with migration, or to delete data and certify deletion. Section 10 (Confidentiality) likewise has no return-or-destroy mechanic. This falls short of even the fallback (90 days of transition assistance plus export within 30 days) and risks walk-away territory, since on exit we would have no contractual right to our own hosted data. Proposed insertion of a transition-assistance, data-return and certified-deletion paragraph at the preferred position (6 months at then-current rates, return within 30 days, deletion certified thereafter).

ops.text: TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF CLIENT DATA. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide reasonable transition assistance, including assistance migrating the Web Site and Client Content to Client or its designee, for up to six (6) months at TrueLink's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Client's request, return to Client all Client Content and other Client data in TrueLink's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Client Content and data from its systems and certify such deletion to Client in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a transition-assistance and data-return provision, as the Agreement currently requires Client to arrange replacement hosting but gives us no right to our own data or migration help on exit. Our position is up to six months of assistance at your then-current rates, return of Client data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter; we can work with 90 days of assistance if that is easier operationally.
proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance, data return within 30 days, and certified deletion into Section 14 (Termination).
